title: Aluminum-Silicon Alloy Microstructure Analysis with High Resolution Phase Contrast Imaging and Lab-DCT Techniques
content: The investigation of microstructures in aluminum-silicon alloys is critical for optimizing their mechanical properties and performance in various applications, particularly in the automotive and aerospace industries. This study employs Zeiss Versa 730 to do high-resolution X-ray microscopy (XRM), phase contrast imaging, and laboratory-based diffraction contrast tomography (Lab-DCT) to provide a comprehensive analysis of the microstructural features of aluminum-silicon alloys.
